mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_priority_draft WHERE year = #{year} AND schoolyear = #{schoolYear}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_priority_draft (year, schoolyear, is_active, created_by) VALUES (#{req.year}, #{req.schoolYear}, #{isActive}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_priority (draft_id, content_id, sort_order) VALUES
(#{draftId}, #{item.contentId}, #{item.sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT bc.content_id, bc.original_title, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, bc.keywords, bc.difficulty, bc.state, bc.image_url, p.sort_order FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_priority_draft d ON d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND d.is_active = 'Y' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_priority p ON p.draft_id = d.draft_id AND p.content_id = bc.content_id WHERE bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.sort_order IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.sort_order ASC, bc.content_id ASC

SELECT d.draft_id, d.year, d.schoolyear, d.is_active, d.created_by, d.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_priority p WHERE p.draft_id = d.draft_id) AS book_count FROM erp_bookstore_priority_draft d WHERE d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

SELECT bc.content_id, bc.original_title, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, bc.keywords, bc.difficulty, bc.state, bc.image_url, p.sort_order FROM erp_bookstore_priority p JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = p.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type WHERE p.draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_priority_draft SET is_active = 'N' WHERE year = #{year} AND schoolyear = #{schoolYear}
UPDATE erp_bookstore_priority_draft SET is_active = 'Y' WHERE draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_priority_draft_del (deleted_by, draft_id, year, schoolyear, is_active, created_by, created_at) SELECT #{deletedBy}, draft_id, year, schoolyear, is_active, created_by, created_at FROM erp_bookstore_priority_draft WHERE draft_id = #{draftId}
INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_priority_del (draft_id, content_id, sort_order) SELECT draft_id, content_id, sort_order FROM erp_bookstore_priority WHERE draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.select: SELECT bc.schoolyear, sc.codeNm AS schoolyear_name, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, bc.original_title, gc.codeNm AS genre_name, bc.difficulty, cd_c.name AS curriculum_name, cd_r.name AS recommend_org_name, cd_a.name AS award_name, p.sort_order FROM erp_bookstore_priority_draft d JOIN erp_bookstore_priority p ON p.draft_id = d.draft_id JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = p.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code gc ON gc.gubun = 'G' AND gc.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code sc ON sc.gubun = 'S' AND sc.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail cd_c ON cd_c.content_id = bc.content_id AND cd_c.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail cd_r ON cd_r.content_id = bc.content_id AND cd_r.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail cd_a ON cd_a.content_id = bc.content_id AND cd_a.gubun = 'A' WHERE d.year = #{year} AND d.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY bc.schoolyear ASC, p.sort_order ASC
